name: hyp-star
comment: Hyperbolic isotoxal star pilot (2026-10-22, AL). Regular {3,4,5,6,8,12} plus every isotoxal star n* (n in the same set) whose POINT angle is 2pi/m, m in {3,4,6} (120, 90, 60 degrees), and is below the regular n-gon's angle (so the Euclidean dent is reflex). alphaU = point in 2pi/240 units. Convention: the point angle is FIXED (hyperbolic stars have a free parameter the plane does not; fixing it at 2pi/m is the plane's own discretization), so only regular corners and dents shrink with edge length, and the forced edge length is solved per tiling (develop_hyperbolic.py). Develop keeps only stars whose dent is still reflex at that length. 2-corner words are admitted: a dent filled by one corner is a real 2-valent vertex in H2 and noncounting, the same convention as the Euclidean star palettes (vertex = at least three tiles). maxValence is NOT a completeness knob here: gen_alphabet's reflex-dent prune bounds every word (2,336 figures at any cap >= 10). Points of 30, 45 and 72 degrees took the count past 135,000 at valence 6 and are left for a second run.
